files.content: # Empty hallway tape — Style Prompt > A camcorder tape recovered from an empty, endless, fluorescent-lit office floor. One handheld first-person take walks a corridor of mustard wallpaper walls with gaps into more empty cubicles, under a column of glowing ceiling panels that ends in a dark zone of dead lights. A calm PA voice gives a rule in black-box captions, the lights black out three times, the camera obeys by staring at its own shoe toes, lifts, and zooms into the dark end where something waits. Dread comes from emptiness, repetition, polite rules and the camera's own machinery, never from a monster. ## 1. Essence, and what it is not - **One first-person camcorder recording**, 4:3 pillarboxed inside 16:9, handheld and continuous. Cuts happen only where the light or the tape breaks (a blackout, a tracking tear, REC off). - **An empty, familiar-but-wrong interior that repeats**: an office floor of partition walls, a hotel corridor, a school wing, a mall after hours. Flat, shadowless fluorescent light; no people. - **Rules instead of monsters.** Notices and PA announcements start ordinary, drift wrong and end up addressing the viewer. The camera obeys them on screen (it stops, looks down, counts). - **The medium tells the story**: the OSD (REC, battery, clock, date), the closed captions, exposure lag, zoom and tape noise carry the plot. - In the example: an escape room's tape. "Aturan dua" on the PA, three blackouts, the operator looks at his shoes and counts, lifts, zooms into the dark end where the one door lights up; the camcorder's title generator writes the name and the chat number. Not a horror film (no creature close-ups, no gore, no jump scares), not a CRT terminal piece (tape and lens artefacts, not phosphor and scanlines), not a ruin (clean is part of the look), not a cartoon (no outlines, no flat cel colour). ## 2. Materials & rendering The source is a lit a 3D engine world. Here the same world is drawn in **Canvas 2D once at load**, at the source's own resolution (720 × 540 plus a margin), and only the finished pictures move. - **Space** (ported from the source with the same seeds): a main corridor 3.4 m wide whose side walls are segments of 3-11 m with 1.5-3 m gaps; behind them a cubicle maze of 0.16 m partition walls on a 2.4 m grid (21% of grid edges), 0.48 m pillars at 7% of grid points, one pillar inside the corridor for depth; ceiling 2.7 m, eye 1.56 m. Only faces visible through the gaps are drawn, in painter's order: outside the corridor first, then the corridor walls, then anything inside it. - **Lights**: 0.6 × 1.2 m panels on a 2.4 m grid, one row on the corridor's centre line, 3.5% dead, 2.5% failing, and **every light dead from 25 to 50 m ahead**: that dead zone is the dark rectangle at the end of the corridor. - **Light without shadows**: each wall gets a horizontal gradient sampled every metre from the source's formula (every light within 6 m: base · N·L · (0.3 + 0.7 cos) / (d² + 0.3) · 2.2, plus bounce base / (h² + 3) · 0.16); floor and ceiling get a gradient along the corridor. **Fog** is exponential, 0.032 per metre, and its colour follows the local light (× 0.15 to 1.25), so dead areas fog to black instead of grey. - **Materials**: wallpaper in 0.53 m rolls with thin double lines every 6.6 cm and a light seam per roll (drawn only where the lines are at least 3 px apart), a dark 0.1 m skirting, a dull 0.35 m band under the ceiling; carpet with grain and 46 large soft damp patches (darker to about 60%); dark olive-grey ceiling. - **Bloom**: a light mask (panels white, every wall drawn black over them) shrunk to 1/4, 1/10 and 1/24 and added back enlarged, so only visible panels glow, in any brand. A soft glow at the top of the frame stands for the panel just overhead. - **Pictures**: 7 keyframes along the walk, one standing view at 1.5× resolution (for the zoom), 6 views down the tilt to the shoes (camera 0.16 m lower and 0.22 m forward when looking down). Per frame at most two of them are visible: crossfaded with a dolly scale between walk keyframes, crossfaded with a vertical offset between tilt angles, and moved by the handheld rotation in 2D. Zoom is a scale of the standing view about the lens centre. - **VHS camcorder pass**: grey luma noise in 3 × 2 px cells, drawn once and moved every tape frame (1/30 s), gain 0.032 rising to 0.11 in the dark; 0-3 white dropout dashes per tape frame (each 45% likely, 2-12% of the width, fading to the right); a head-switching band on the bottom 18 px; a 42% lens vignette; corners rounded 34/26 px for the barrel. No scanlines, no RGB mask. - **OSD** in the source's own 5 × 7 dot-matrix font (3 px dots in tape space, a black outline): REC dot, three-bar battery, time and date. Captions are not part of the tape (the TV decodes them). - **Footage**: the corridor is a stand-in; with the user's own clip from `list_media`, play it inside the 4:3 frame and keep the OSD, captions, noise, vignette and blackouts on top. ## 3. Colour logic - `--latar-2` is the room's material. Walls are `color-mix(--latar-2 78%, #9a8228)`: the fixed mustard is the fluorescent light's cast, so any brand still looks lit by sickly tubes (a white brand gives a cream office, a navy brand a grey institutional one). Carpet, ceiling, fog (`--kabut`) and the unlit dark (`--gelap`) are mixed from the walls; the script reads these tokens once through a canvas and mixes them, so the pictures follow the brand. - `--latar` is the caption box behind every row and the outline around the title text; `--teks` is the caption text and the title's smaller lines. - `--utama` is **the one saturated colour**: the door in the dark zone, its arrow sign and its glow, dark until the call to action. `--teks-di-utama` is not needed (the sign is a pictogram). - `--utama-di-latar` colours the title generator's big first line; `--aksen-di-latar` colours the `[PA]` speaker tag in the caption box. - Fixed in every brand: the OSD white `#f4f4ee` with a black outline, the REC dot `#e8261c`, the bars, the light panels `#fbfaf0`, the shoes `#2a2521`. - The reference: walls `#9c8a42`-`#b09a46`, carpet `#736221`, ceiling `#66644e`-`#878568`, light panels `#fefcea`, the dark end `#46442e` fading to black, captions pure white on black. ## 4. Type - `--font-isi` carries the closed captions, ported from the source: IBM Plex Mono 600 at 42 px, rows 54 px, each row its own `--latar` box one character wider on each side, centred in the 4:3 frame with the last row centred at y 852 of the frame. At most 32 characters a row. Speaker marks in brackets (`[PA]`), sound descriptions in capitals in brackets (`[LAMPU PADAM]`), the operator's own words in italics. - `--font-judul` carries the camcorder title generator: VT323 at 150 px for the name and 66 px for the following lines, letter spacing 0.08em, a 4 px `--latar` outline, centred below the vanishing point, typed at 32 characters a second. - The OSD keeps its dot-matrix face: `● REC` top left, battery top right, time and date bottom right, 50 px from the right edge in tape space. - When the brand has no fonts: a monospace for captions (IBM Plex Mono, Space Grotesk at 40 px), a bitmap face for titles (VT323, Press Start 2P at half size). ## 5. Motion quality All numbers are the source's, its 12 s clip stretched × 1.25 to 15 s. - **Lens and pose**: 52° horizontal (focal 1456 px on the 1420 px frame), pitch −0.06 rad (horizon at 42% height), a constant roll of 0.012 rad. - **Walk**: a step every 0.72 m; head bob 0.032 m × (|sin| − 0.6), sway 0.018 m, yaw 0.011 rad and roll 0.014 rad per step, all scaled by speed. The walk decelerates and stops at 3.5 s; the rest of the clip is standing. - **Handheld**: pitch noise 0.016 rad at 1.1 Hz, 0.005 × (1 + 2 fear) at 3.7 Hz, 0.0022 × fear at 9.5 Hz, breathing 0.006 at 0.27 Hz; yaw 0.018 at 0.9 Hz and 0.005 × (1 + 2 fear) at 3.3 Hz; roll 0.035 at 0.6 Hz and 0.003 × fear at 7 Hz. Fear goes 0.2 → 0.3 → 0.85 at the blackouts → 0.7 → 0.9 at the zoom. **At the held breath (12.8 s) all of it freezes in 0.35 s.** - **Blackouts**: light drops to 2.5% for 0.16, 0.19 and 0.21 s, 0.63 s apart, and returns from 55% to full over 0.13 s; after the third it climbs from 90% over 0.9 s. Auto gain remembers the dark for 0.56 s: exposure × (1 + 0.45 · memory) overshoots after each relight and the noise rises. - **Glance down**: pitch to −1.28 rad in 0.38 s (monotone cubic), drifting to −1.2 over 2.8 s, then up to level over 1.5 s; the shoes leave the frame before the walls return. While the camera looks down, something passes overhead: the lights within 2.6 m go out one by one from far to near (1 − 0.85 · e^(−Δz²/1.2)), darkening the carpet for about a second. - **Zoom**: 52° to 27° over 1.5 s, then held, so every shake doubles on screen. - **Captions**: pop-on and hard cut, never faded. The rule holds until the first blackout, a sound tag 2.5 s, a count paints on word by word 0.6 s apart, the operator's line about 1.2 s. - **Signal**: the door lights with a restrike (on, 20%, on, 35%, on within 0.25 s), then stays. ## 6. Camera grammar | Move | What it expresses | Can serve | |---|---|---| | Walking POV down the corridor, slowing to a stop | routine, then attention | establishing the space, the first rule | | Lights black out, exposure lags back | the building is not on your side | the problem, a warning, a turn | | Glance down at the shoe toes | obedience, avoidance | obeying a rule, counting, not looking | | Slow lift from the floor back to the corridor | resolve, carrying on | the next step, "keep going" | | Zoom into the dark end, shake doubled | seeing and not seeing | a presence, a doubt, the destination | | Lower to a printed notice, lens parallel, hold 3 s | reading, bureaucracy | a rule, a list, a contradiction | | Identical framing after a tracking tear, only the OSD changed | time removed | a jump, before and after, a loss | | Held breath: every shake freezes | a threshold | the ending, the name and contact | | Camera set down, recording alone | abandonment | the payoff, a long wait | Framing: captions uncovered and readable; anything strange small, far and in the dark zone; the brand's colour appears once, at the end of the corridor. ## 7. Native moves - **Rules as captions.** A calm PA announcement in a black-box caption gives an ordinary rule that is slightly wrong, and the camera then obeys it. *Fits content like:* an escape room's "Aturan dua"; a museum's after-hours rules for a night tour; a teacher's exam-room rules for a study channel; a short story where the hotel's rules keep changing. - **Three blackouts with exposure lag.** The lights die for about 0.2 s three times; each time they come back from half and overshoot as the auto gain catches up. *Fits content like:* the problem beat of a power-bank shop's ad; a creator's "listrik padam pas live"; a science class on how cameras adjust to light; the moment a mystery turns. - **Looking at the shoes.** The camera snaps down to the carpet and two shoe toes while words are counted, something dims the light overhead, then the camera lifts slowly. *Fits content like:* steps of a walking tour; a shoe shop's "langkah pertama"; a mindfulness teacher counting breaths; a character who will not look up. - **Zoom into the dark zone.** The corridor ends in a block of dead lights; the lens zooms 52° to 27° into it and the one thing there lights up. *Fits content like:* the booking line of an escape room; the shop that stays open at 3 a.m.; the enrolment link of a horror-writing class; the exit at the end of a story. - **The OSD is evidence.** REC, battery, time and date stay on screen and can change: a clock jump after a tear, a battery that drains, a date that should not be possible. *Fits content like:* a dated renovation walkthrough; a creator's "diary" tape; a history lesson stamped with a year; an alibi in a detective short. ## 8. Pitfalls - **Performance.** Do not build the space as CSS 3D planes: the live preview often runs with a software compositor, where about 75 perspective planes cost about 70 ms a frame. Draw each view once into a canvas, turn it into an `` (a canvas layer is pushed again on every commit), and per frame only move one or two images and a few overlays. Paint the bloom from small canvases, never with a large blur. Write a style property only when its value changes, and hide full-frame overlays (`visibility`) when their opacity is zero. - **Load time**: 14 views take about a second on a busy machine; trim walk keyframes before adding detail, and keep wallpaper lines to those at least 3 px apart. - **A fully bright scene reads as a hospital corridor**: keep the dead-light zone, fog colour that follows local light, and darker cubicles behind the gaps. - **Light brands**: bloom from a brightness threshold would make cream walls glow; build it from a light mask. - **The signal colour**: one saturated thing only. Keep the door dark until the call to action. - **Text**: captions sit on their own `--latar` boxes and are never covered by noise or blackouts; title text carries a `--latar` outline; the title's last line ends above the OSD time. - **Footage and sound**: no sound in the render; the PA voice exists only as captions. ## Measured from the reference The reference is a 12 s clip (24 fps) from the middle of the source film. The camera walks with a three-row PA caption until 2.8 s and stops; the lights black out at 3.12, 3.62 and 4.12 s (relit 3.25, 3.79, 4.29: reflab's cuts and internal changes); the camera snaps down by 4.55 s and holds on the carpet and two shoe toes, lifts from 6.8 to 8.0 s, zooms from 7.9 to 9.1 s, and the operator's one-word italic line appears at 9.75 s. Palette per shot: `#5c5229` 37%, `#867a46` 32%, black bars 28%, `#d4d1ba` 3%; the dark shot `#0e0c05` 62%. The example keeps every one of these times × 1.25 and replaces the last line with its call to action. ## Variation space Decide the location and its material colour (the brand's `--latar-2`), the reason for filming, the rules, the presence (or none), the signal colour (the brand's `--utama`), the opening, the ending and the length. Structures: the same route filmed twice a year apart; a cheerful property walkthrough while the building keeps adding rooms; a checklist read aloud until an item is not on the list. Openings: mid-sentence with tracking still rolling in; a date slate before the camera is picked up. Endings: the battery icon blinks and the frame freezes; the camera is set down and keeps recording; the tape loops back to the first shot.

# Empty hallway tape: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.8, long 4.2.

## hook

- en: handheld walk down the lit corridor, slowing to a stop; a PA rule pops on as a black-box caption
- id: kamera genggam berjalan di lorong berlampu neon lalu berhenti; aturan dari pengeras suara muncul di kotak teks hitam

## problem

- en: the lights black out three times (0.15-0.2 s), auto-exposure overshoots back; an SDH tag names it
- id: lampu padam tiga kali (0,15-0,2 detik), eksposur otomatis kebablasan saat menyala; label [LAMPU PADAM] menamainya

## fact

- en: a printed notice on a pillar; the camera lowers until the lens is parallel to it and holds 3 s to read
- id: kertas pengumuman di pilar; kamera merendah sampai sejajar kertas dan diam 3 detik supaya terbaca

## step

- en: the camera glances down at the shoe toes on the carpet; the count paints on word by word
- id: kamera menunduk ke ujung sepatu di karpet; hitungan muncul kata demi kata

## compare

- en: identical framing before and after a tracking tear; only the OSD clock and one detail have changed
- id: bingkai sama persis sebelum dan sesudah pita kaset robek; hanya jam OSD dan satu detail yang berubah

## number

- en: the OSD carries the figure: the clock, date or battery changes on screen as evidence
- id: angka dibawa OSD kamera: jam, tanggal, atau baterai berubah di layar sebagai bukti

## proof

- en: the lens zooms 52° to 27° into the dark zone of dead lights until the detail shows, every shake doubled
- id: lensa zoom ke zona lampu mati di ujung lorong sampai detailnya terlihat, goyangan ikut membesar

## offer

- en: zoom into the dark end; the one door or sign in the brand colour lights up with a flickering restrike
- id: zoom ke ujung yang gelap; satu pintu atau tanda berwarna brand menyala sambil berkedip

## cta

- en: every shake freezes (held breath); the camcorder title generator types name and contact, held 2 s
- id: goyangan kamera membeku; teks judul camcorder mengetik nama dan kontak, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the camera is set down and keeps recording the empty corridor alone; the last line pops on, held 2 s
- id: kamera diletakkan dan terus merekam lorong kosong sendirian; kalimat terakhir muncul, diam 2 detik

        /* Milik kamera: OSD, titik REC, pita hitam di luar bingkai 4:3. */

        --pita: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 10%, #000000);

        --lampu: #fbfaf0;
        --dinding: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2) 78%, #9a8228);
        --karpet: color-mix(in oklab, var(--dinding) 70%, #5a4510);
        --plafon: color-mix(in oklab, var(--dinding) 28%, #8a8670);

        --sepatu: #2a2521;
      }
      html, body { margin: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--pita); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--pita); }
      /* Bingkai 4:3 1420 × 1066, sudut melengkung (lensa). */
      #tv { position: absolute; left: 250px; top: 7px; width: 1420px; height: 1066px; overflow: hidden; z-index: 0;
        border-radius: 34px / 26px; background: var(--gelap); }
      .lap { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1420px; height: 1066px; }
      /* Pandangan 760 × 700 (720 × 540 sumber + tepi), tampil 1500 × 1382. */
      .vw { position: absolute; left: -40px; top: -158px; width: 1500px; height: 1382px; transform-origin: 750px 691px; visibility: hidden; will-change: transform, opacity; }
      .vw img { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      /* Pintu di zona lampu mati: satu-satunya warna jenuh (--utama). */
      .pintu { position: absolute; background: linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 78%, var(--lampu)), var(--utama) 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 80%, var(--gelap)));
        border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 35%, var(--gelap)); box-sizing: border-box; }
      .pintu::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 35%, var(--gelap)); }
      .tanda { position: absolute; background: var(--gelap); box-shadow: 0 0 6px 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 70%, transparent); }
      .tanda::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 20% 18%; background: var(--utama);
        clip-path: polygon(0 50%, 22% 0, 22% 30%, 78% 30%, 78% 0, 100% 50%, 78% 100%, 78% 70%, 22% 70%, 22% 100%); }
      .pijar { position: absolute; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 45%, transparent), transparent); }
      .spt { fill: url(#kilap); } .kil { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--sepatu) 70%, var(--lampu)); opacity: 0.22; }
      /* Silau lampu; lapisan gelap (padam) dan terang (AGC). */
      #sorot { z-index: 3; height: 420px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 340px 200px at 710px -30px, var(--lampu), color-mix(in oklab, var(--lampu) 45%, transparent) 45%, transparent); }
      #padam { z-index: 4; background: var(--gelap); }

      #terang { z-index: 6; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--lampu) 80%, var(--dinding)); }
      /* Judul camcorder, garis tepi --latar. */
      #judul { z-index: 8; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 616px; width: 1420px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-judul);
        color: var(--teks); text-shadow: 4px 0 var(--latar), -4px 0 var(--latar), 0 4px var(--latar), 0 -4px var(--latar),
          3px 3px var(--latar), -3px 3px var(--latar), 3px -3px var(--latar), -3px -3px var(--latar); }
      #judul div { font-size: 66px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
      #judul .besar { font-size: 150px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      /* Kaset: bintik digeser tiap 1/30 s, garis putus, pita head-switch. */
      #bising { z-index: 9; position: absolute; left: -40px; top: -40px; width: 1500px; height: 1146px; background: var(--t-bising) 0 0 / 900px 600px; }
      .putus { z-index: 9; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100px; height: 2px; transform-origin: 0 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lampu), transparent); }
      #hs { z-index: 10; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1480px; height: 18px; opacity: 0.3; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lampu) 0 7px, transparent 7px 23px); }
      /* OSD + vinyet lensa 42% (vhs.js) dalam satu lapisan. */
      #osd { z-index: 11; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 1136px 1066px at 50% 50%, transparent 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--pita) 10%, transparent) 40%,
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--pita) 21%, transparent) 52.5%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--pita) 33%, transparent) 65%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--pita) 42%, transparent) 85%); }
      /* Teks tertutup CEA-608: kotak --latar per baris. */
      .cc { z-index: 13; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 187px; width: 1420px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-isi);
        font-weight: 600; font-size: 42px; line-height: 54px; color: var(--teks); }
      .cc span { background: var(--latar); padding: 0 0.6em; }

    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div id="tv">
        <!-- Pandangan lorong digambar sekali (kanvas), lalu hanya digeser dan dilarutkan. -->
        <div id="views" style="z-index: 1"></div>
        <svg class="lap" id="sepatu" style="z-index: 2" viewBox="0 0 1420 1066"></svg>
        <div class="lap" id="sorot"></div><div class="lap" id="padam"></div>
        <div class="lap" id="terang"></div>
        <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: berjalan menyusuri lorong; aturan dari pengeras suara. -->

        <!-- Adegan 2, masalah: lampu padam tiga kali, eksposur telat menyusul. -->
        <div data-role="problem" id="s2"><div class="cc" id="kt2"><div><span>[LAMPU PADAM]</span></div></div></div>
        <!-- Adegan 3, langkah: menatap ujung sepatu; hitungan per kata. -->

        <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: zoom ke ujung gelap, pintu menyala, judul camcorder, diam. -->
        <div data-role="cta" id="s4">
          <div class="cc op" id="kt4"><div><span>Itu pintunya?</span></div></div>
          <div id="judul"><div class="besar">LANTAI NOL</div><div>ESCAPE ROOM</div><div>Chat 0812-3456-7890</div></div>
        </div>
        <div id="hs"></div>

    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id), css = document.documentElement.style, fn = "url";
      const P0 = 1456, END = 15, D = 180 / Math.PI; // lensa 52°
      // Pembantu core/lib.js sumber.
